name: Spirit Duplicator
desc: Copies landing in the delivery tray of a ditto machine — a typed and hand-drawn master coming off the drum in aniline purple, each sheet skewed a little further and a little fainter than the last, drum streaks and starved edges and the ghost of the sheet underneath, until the master gives out and a fresh one goes on.

energy.doc: how fast the operator is cranking — feed rate, streak contrast, how hard the basement light falls off

density.doc: how deep the tray is stacked (3 to 5 sheets) and how full the master is typed

scale.doc: sheet size in the frame, and the body size of the typing

hue.doc: duplicator ink hue — 282 is ditto purple; carries stock and machine bed with it

starve.doc: drum streaking and how badly the ink runs out across the sheet

act.doc: multi-minute program: a normal run / short runs, the master gives out fast and gets replaced / a long clean run off a new master

style.doc: aesthetic: aniline purple spirit duplicator / dark blue-black stencil mimeograph / a smudged grey carbon flimsy / red duplicator ink / not a copy at all: the cut wax stencil itself, the image reading as holes in a solid ink field

seed.doc: deterministic master — the lock-up, typing, diagram, per-copy skew and streaks
